newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ray Burke appointed Irish Foreign Minister.
newsitem.headline: Ray Burke appointed Irish Foreign Minister.

text.p: Irish Prime Minister bertie Ahern on Thursday named Ray Burke Foreign Affairs minister.
The 53-year-old Bruke will have responsibility for handling Northern Ireland, which Ahern said was the centre-right government's most urgent priority.
Burke, a member of Ahern's Fianna Fail party, has held a number of ministerial posts including Justice, Industry and Communications between 1987 and 1991.
He was Foreign Affairs spokesman in opposition and is viewed as dependable and solid, key attributes in searching for a solution to the Northern Ireland conflict, in which 3,200 people have died.

The Foreign Affairs brief was previously held by Dick Spring, head of the Labour party. Its occupants meet regularly with their British counterparts in an Anglo-Irish conference set up to stuly solutions to the Northern Ireland problem.
